Ana (CS): Heads-up — Miramar renewal mid-May. We saw a weird usage spike last 10 days, want a quick burnstomp + enablement pulse before the QBR. Who can own cost mitigation + short enablement run? :eyes:
Jordan - FinOps: I can take the forecast side. Quick numbers show token usage jumped ~3.6x on their embed pipelines. Current monthly estimate -> `~$42k` if trend holds. :warning:
Sam (Onboarding): they're doing heavy batch re-ingestion and forgot caching on the inference path. I flagged a few jobs yesterday to pause. Will patch caching in dev today.
Priya (Enablement): I can run a 30m session with their engineering team tomorrow to cover prefix caching + cheaper model fallbacks. Also prepare a short checklist for ops folks.
Mike (AM): They said they need predictability, not surprises. Can we give a 2-week plan and an expected post-mitigation spend curve? Add this to the renewal talking points.
BudgetBot: Alert: Miramar account usage >= 85% of retained credits threshold. Recent 24h burst: `+1.2M tokens` above baseline.
Ana (CS): Proposed immediate steps: 1) temp throttle embeddings (reduce batch size) 2) enable prefix/KV cache for replays 3) switch non-prod to 4-bit quantized variant for re-ingest backfill 4) schedule enablement session.
Jordan - FinOps: Forecast snippet (rough):
```
current_rate_tokens_per_day: 4_200_000
baseline_tokens_per_day: 1_150_000
projected_monthly_cost_current: $42,000
projected_monthly_cost_mitigated: $12,500
```
If we hit the mitigated plan, savings ~70% by month end. I'll prepare a slide with that delta.
Sam (Onboarding): Confirmed: I can pause two heavy jobs for 24h and push cache changes to staging. Need @Priya to join the call for runbook sign-off.
Priya (Enablement): I'll slot 30m tomorrow 11:00am PT. Draft runbook items: 
- short-term throttles + retention caps
- how to enable prefix caching (config snippet)
- model fallback matrix (latency vs cost)
- verification steps for billing tags
Please add any missing ops checks.
Mike (AM): I'll update renewal notes and ask legal to hold off on final renewal language until we show the mitigation plan. Customer is open to a 30-day credit conversation if we hit targets.
Jordan - FinOps: I'll own the spend forecast and update the dashboard.
Sam (Onboarding): I'll own the technical mitigations and confirm when caches are live.
Ana (CS): Great — owners assigned: Jordan (forecast + deck), Sam (mitigations), Priya (enablement run). Mike to cover renewal comms. I'll run the QBR slide assembly.
Mike (AM): Add me as backup for enablement session in case of timezone issue.
Ana (CS): Ok team — next check-in here after Priya's session. Adding follow-ups: quick smoke test results, updated forecast screenshot, and confirmation that BudgetBot went green. :thumbsup:
BudgetBot: Follow-up: threshold will auto-re-evaluate in 6h.
Ana (CS): Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for the Miramar "burnstomp" action items.
Priya (Enablement): noted, see you tomorrow. :calendar:
